Input:fieldApiName.title: fieldApiName
Input:fieldApiName.description: Take this from user. Required only when requesting fieldpermissions access. If this value is not available, Pass None as the value.

Input:objectApiName.title: objectApiName
Input:objectApiName.description: Take this from user. Exact object api name required.

Input:entityType.title: entityType
Input:entityType.description: Value for this can be either ObjectPermissions or FieldPermissions depending upon which access user is trying to check.
